listings.label: V Pho
listings.tagline: Build-your-own pho, noodle soups and Vietnamese plates in Campbell.
listings.address: 930 W Hamilton Ave, Ste 110, Campbell, CA 95008
listings.quoteOnly: Menu prices are from V Pho. Order directly with the restaurant or its delivery partners.

panels.head: Menu and ordering
body: Last calls and takeaway orders finish 15 minutes before closing. DIY pho includes two proteins; shrimp and fish ball with roe add $1, squid adds $1.50. Selected vegetables add $1.
Drink toppings: boba +$0.50, crystal boba +$1, mango, strawberry, rainbow, lychee or coffee jelly +$0.75. The published chicken pho lunch special is $12.99 from 11am to 3pm.

sourceNotes.V Pho: Own website /menu/ pages 2–9, screenshot IMG_9450 and profile IMG_9453; all 83 menu entries transcribed, including DIY variants and lunch special.
sourceNotes.Master Oh: Existing page and full menu retained, artwork replaced from IMG_9457 and added to Seafood/Crab Boil via its corrected type line.
sourceNotes.Chahalo: Glenn’s profile and contact screenshots plus the Berkeley Chowbus menu. A fermented-rice drink is omitted; base prices and modifiers are not conflated. No schedule inferred from ordering hours.
sourceNotes.Maillards: Own website menu for Noriega and Sunday market. Hours omitted because the supplied profile announces Tuesday opening while the site lists Wednesday–Sunday.
sourceNotes.Riceful: Own menu.html provides all dishes and ingredients without prices. Prices display Ask shop; full menu and official Snackpass ordering links retained.
sourceNotes.Champ Onigiri: Supplied profile gives daytime onigiri hours, phone and email. Do not substitute Ramen Champ’s different evening ramen menu. No published onigiri price list verified.
sourceNotes.Halal Street: Glenn requested website pilot prospect status. Current official Newark site and Chowbus takeaway menu retained with needsSite true. Dine-in buffet promotions remain in source credits rather than permanent prices.
sourceNotes.Browser sources: Two @rainmoreturely reels were verified in signed-in Chrome; observed video/audio assets downloaded and muxed. Champ post discloses sponsorship.
